question: What must change to test a Qwen3 7–8B computation channel on the existing instance?

hardware.source: Filtered actual neuron-ls -j; no instance identifiers or process fields retained

current_full_training_lower_bounds.reason: ZeRO-1 shards optimizer state, while this driver retains complete BF16 parameters and gradients per rank. Their 30.51GiB alone exceeds24GiB, before optimizer, activations and compiler scratch.

required_checks: Exact released-weight loading with untied head and native tokenizer
CPU/BF16 device forward and cached-generation checks on declared shapes
Measured device memory including executable scratch, cache and activations
Measured first-compile and warm inference cost

adapter_candidate.assumptions: All base weights, including embeddings, head, and norms, are frozen. No embedding/head adapters in this count. Activation, scratch, padding and all communication allocations excluded.
required_changes: Actual frozen-base adapter forward and gradient verification
Current reentrant trunk checkpointing must receive a gradient-bearing input after frozen embeddings; simply freezing the backbone can suppress adapter gradients
FP32 adapter-master update and true fresh-process full restore
Measured device/host memory and useful target-shape throughput

sharded_full_training_candidate.requires: Parameter/gradient sharding or tensor parallelism, not more ZeRO-1 ranks alone

tutorial_limit: The official example uses a different installed training stack and tensor parallelism; public support is not a qualification of this environment.
decision: Complete the already frozen teacher/student/compact-CoT comparison first. Choose a writer or reader capacity intervention from the failed causal link. No 8B asset download or run started.

installed_optimizer_hook_inspection.observation: _make_param_hook allocates optimizer-dtype main_grad with the complete param.shape; _reduce_gradients performs reduce_scatter during step. This hook is not backward-time gradient sharding.
installed_optimizer_hook_inspection.implication: Enabling use_grad_acc_hook cannot resolve the replicated 8B gradient-memory lower bound.
